anomalies.details: Publication list rendered as "No results found." while sibling pages research/index/ and research/index/release/ fetched normally in the same run; almost certainly a client-render/filter race in our fetch, not a real content removal. Watch next run.

Approx. 1500 lines of body content (Coding/Safety/Conclusion/Appendix sections) that were absent in the prior snapshot reappeared in full. Confirms 2026-09-22 hypothesis that similar losses on other index/* posts were fetch-rendering artifacts rather than deliberate edits. The 4 pages flagged 2026-09-22 (evaluating-chain-of-thought-monitorability, frontierscience, gdpval, introducing-indqa) did NOT recover content this run.
